services:
  # ========== MySQL Database ==========
  mysql:
    image: mysql:8.0
    container_name: serviceku-mysql
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD:-serviceku_root_pass}
      MYSQL_DATABASE: ${DB_DATABASE:-serviceku_master}
      MYSQL_USER: ${DB_USERNAME:-serviceku}
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD:-serviceku_pass}
    ports:
      - "3306:3306"
    volumes:
      - mysql_data:/var/lib/mysql
      - ./docker/mysql/my.cnf:/etc/mysql/conf.d/my.cnf
    networks:
      - serviceku-network
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "mysqladmin", "ping", "-h", "localhost", "-u", "root", "-p serviceku_root_pass"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  # ========== phpMyAdmin (for management) ==========
  phpmyadmin:
    image: phpmyadmin:latest
    container_name: serviceku-phpmyadmin
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PMA_HOST: mysql
      PMA_PORT: 3306
      PMA_USER: root
      PMA_PASSWORD: s
metadata.README.md:
🔧 ServiceKU

SaaS Multi-Tenant Service Center Management Platform

--- ## 📋 Tentang ServiceKU ServiceKU adalah platform manajemen pusat servis elektronik & handphone berbasis **SaaS Multi-Tenant**. Dibangun dengan **Laravel 11 + Vue 3 (Composition API) + Inertia.js**. ### Fitur Utama | Modul | Fitur | |---|---| | 🔧 **Service/Repair** | Ticket lifecycle, foto (Google Drive), spare parts, checklist, transfer antar teknisi | | 💰 **POS/Sales** | Cash register, invoice, payment tracking, multi-store | | 👥 **Customer** | CRUD, member card, loyalty points, history servis | | 📦 **Inventory** | Produk, stock mutation, low stock alert, purchase order, return, stock allocation | | 💵 **Finance** | Expenses (dengan foto), daily deposit, commission, reconciliation, tax settings | | 🏢 **Multi-Branch** | Multiple cabang, transfer stock antar cabang | | 👨‍🔧 **HR** | Shift, absensi, multi-role users (Owner/Admin/CS/Teknisi/Kasir/Kurir) | | 📊 **Reporting** | 9 jenis report: sales, services, finance, inventory, commissions, customer analytics, productivity, revenue comparison | | 📖 **Knowledge Base** | SOP
